profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Milwaukee Tool
profile.summary:
IT professional with over 18 years of experience in software application design, development and support which include 13 years specializing in Microsoft Dynamics AX.  Participated in the development and maintenance of MS Dynamics AX ERP system, B2B data communications, C#/VB.Net applications, web portals, and reporting. 

Having worked in small to medium sized companies gives me the ability to wear many hats. One day I can be engaged in development and another day interacting with end users to solve a critical operation.  I find that this helps me understand the business as a whole which I can leverage to help build better solutions.

positions.title: Sr. Full-Stack Developer / Dynamics AX Developer
positions.description:
•	Assist in the full stack development of the company’s in-house application called VALO Procure.
•	Provide software architectural designs for continued development in VALO Procure and AX 2012.
•	Build and maintain the integration between VALO Procure and AX 2012 which use the Business Connector and/or AIF.
•	Champion all aspects of AX 2012 which include development, design and support.
•	Mentor and advise team members regarding the AX platform and general software development best practices.

positions.title: Sr. Application Developer/Dynamics AX Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed and built the interface used to send electronic vendor payments to our various banks domestic and international in AX2009 and AX2012.
•	Provide continued development, maintenance and support for company's AX2012 system.
•	Interact with end-users on a daily basis to gather requirements or support daily operations
•	Assisted in the implementation of the AX2012 system and provided root cause analysis for our Microsoft Partners.
•	Developed ETL packages to support SSRS reports and interfaces out of AX2012 using SQL and SSIS packages.
•	Advise our Business Intelligence team on the database structure of AX2012

positions.title: Sr. Application Developer/Dynamics AX Developer
positions.description:
•	Responsible for the maintenance and development of the company’s ERP system MS Dynamics AX 2009.
•	Support daily operations in regards to the ERP system.
•	Developed the integration between MS CRM and AX using the .Net business connector and CRM plugins.
•	Modules supported HR, Project Accounting, AP, AR, General Ledger
•	Interact with end users daily for gathering requirements concerning projects and support 
•	Work with vendors on outsourced projects
•	Developed a Payroll Change process in AX for HR which will eliminate the use of paper as well as improving their workflow.

positions.title: Applications Developer/ Dynamics AX Developer
positions.description:
•	Develop and maintain all functionality of the company’s ERP system, MS Dynamics AX.
•	Create various web portals within Sharepoint using C# and ASP.Net for external and internal users.
•	Maintain all .NET and SQL legacy applications and automated processes.
•	Develop/Support external applications which interact with Dynamics AX
•	Provide IT system support for 200+ users countrywide
•	Create and support B2B transactions to Customers and Vendors using XML, Flat files and web services.
•	Provide reports to all levels of management using Sharepoint, MS SQL, SSRS and SSIS
•	Interact with users and management on a daily basis to gather requirements, feedback and support
•	Aid and Mentor Jr. Developer with all aspects of application development and support
•	Participated in the upgrade of Dynamics AX ver. 4 to AX 2009

positions.title: Programmer Analyst/Technical Support Specialist
positions.description:
•	Assist Sr. Programmer with the design of new features and enhancements for the company’s flag ship application.
•	Responsible for about 70% of all software implementation and development.
•	Provide first round of software testing by using various combinations of anticipated user scenarios.
•	Develop the business logic which interfaces with the Macromedia FLASH front-end.
•	Software development using VB6/VB.Net, ADO, DAO, MS Access, SQL, HTML, XML, Microsoft Window’s APIs, GUI interface design, Touch-screen monitors, and Communication Port Device.
•	Redesign and implement existing features previously created in VB6 to VB.Net.
•	Provide technical support for national and international customers regarding the diagnostic system through telephone and email correspondence.
